title: I recently released my brick-breaker and I need feedback on the power-ups. How do they look?
author: Disastrous-Shift-92
selftext:
Hi everyone! I recently released Nebulite, a brick-breaker where the breakout
    is just the core: between levels you explore a procedurally generated star map,
    collect minerals, upgrade your ship and take on missions.
    
    This clip shows all 26 good ones, one per letter, Z to A.
    (Sound on: the announcer calls out each one.)
    
    Can you tell what each power-up does just by watching?
    Do any of them look confusing, weak, or too similar to another?
    Do the effects feel satisfying when you catch them?
    
    Any feedback helps, even the harsh kind. Thanks!
    
    It's available in the browser, Android and iOS.

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/Disastrous-Shift-92 please add details on how AI was used to make this. Just stating that you used AI doesn't pass the rule. The community is a dev community, add dev details. Rule 4 is there to make sure promotional posts contribute by getting into the process and actual development. There's a real risk of the sub being swamped by self-promotion. If you don't update, this post may be removed.

comments.author: zimmer550king
comments.body: What makes this different from all the other million brick breakers out there?

replies.author: Disastrous-Shift-92
replies.body:
It's not a brick-breaker with X levels and that's it.
There's a story, main and side missions, hidden items to find, ship
upgrades, and a huge star map packed with levels to explore.

I'd say it's less a brick-breaker and more an RPG whose levels happen
to be brick-breaker stages. The power-ups are just one piece of it,
which is why I wanted feedback on them first.

If you give it a try, I'd love to know if that comes across!
